title: Pt Modi 'S Mann Ki Baat | June 2019 | First mann ki baat after re-election
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the nation on Sunday 30 June through his monthly radio broadcast 'Mann ki Baat'. This is his first radio address after leading the BJP to a grand victory in the Lok Sabha elections. The PM took note of the growing water crisis in parts of the country, urging people to preserve every drop of water. Modi also spoke on the BJP's victory in the 2019 Lok Sabha elections, saying he was confident of his win as he had faith in people.
